description: A jQuery plugin for creating accessible radio button switch widgets with on/off states, including initialization, state management, enabling/disabling, and event handling.

methods.name: __init
methods.description: Initializes the radioswitch widget, creates DOM elements, and binds event handlers.

methods.name: __doSwitch
methods.description: Internal method to switch the widget state between 'on' and 'off'.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Placeholder for future options modification; currently not allowing changes after init.

methods.name: doSwitch
methods.description: Public method to switch the widget state and optionally trigger a change event.

methods.name: doEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables the entire widget, affecting user interaction.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the widget, including whether it is on and enabled.
